statistic: median of within-fork median paired ratios; fork ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals

timing_scope.operation: ordinary one-shot API including new caller input arrays/options on every call
timing_scope.single: first cryptographic operation in a new process; import/fixture loading excluded
timing_scope.startup_inclusive: parent-observed process lifetime including startup, imports, fixture loading, operation, equality checks, serialization and exit

correctness.allocation_metric: Int32Array constructor calls and requested byteLength; not heap or peak memory
